why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Nick Yorke is slot #8 (4.526 expected team runs/game).
Slots #8, #7, #9, #6, #3 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #5 ranks 6 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.010 R/G.
Slot #8 yields 3.93 expected PA/game vs 4.26 at primary slot #5. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.006 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
